capabilities: Author branching story graphs with typed nodes, links, and frames
Playtest narratives with variables, conditions, effects, and validation
Manage a story library of characters, locations, items, and lore with backlinks
Round-trip narrative content with Ink, Yarn, Twee, and Markdown script editors
Export projects to Runtime JSON, Yarn, Ink, Twee, Godot Dialogic 2, and Unreal formats
disambiguation: Not built on Obsidian's core Canvas; projects are stored in the plugin's own .ncanvas file format.
extras: Portable exports and the AI copilot are marked Beta; the core plugin makes no network requests and stores everything in vault .ncanvas files, but the copilot sends data to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The interface is bilingual (English and Chinese), and very large PNG exports can consume substantial memory.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated node-graph workspace for structuring nonlinear stories with choices, conditions, variables, and playtesting.

relations.evidence: exports Twee 3 .twee passages for Twine / Tweego, including SugarCube StoryData
exports an editable .dtl timeline with labels, choices, conditions, variable effects, jumps
exports .conversation.json, an importer-oriented graph payload with entry points, participants, routes
Ink: exports .ink knots, VAR declarations, sticky + choices, diverts, and ~ assignments
Yarn: exports .yarn nodes, shortcut options, variable declarations, <<jump>>, and <<set>> commands

summary: Node-based editor for branching narratives with playable previews, story logic, and exports to Ink, Yarn, Twee, Godot, and Unreal formats.
